summary: Kerb along Christ Church frontage; homes only across the road, cars park here.
reasons: Church on kerb side, no dwelling

best_section.where: Ninth Avenue kerb beside Christ Church, west side

drivers.seclusion: West side backs onto church and hall (8m, non-residential). Nearest homes 15-24m across the road; apartments 38m behind the church.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with cars parked along the kerb in QLD imagery; room to park fully off the lane.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street off a main road at the top; light traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars park along this kerb; a van would blend in. Signs are 3P Mon-Fri daytime, resident permits excepted.

flags: Steep over whole stretch: mean 4.4%, max 8%
sun_shade: Street trees and church-side trees give partial shade, mainly from the west and north.
